sentences.en: MAN: Good morning
sentences.zh: MAN: 早上好

sentences.en: WOMAN: Hi, this is Michelin Meyer
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你好，我是米歇尔·迈耶。

sentences.en: I'm renting your house on Archwood Avenue
sentences.zh: 我租了你们位于阿奇伍德大道的房子。

sentences.en: I'm due to move in next week
sentences.zh: 我预计下周搬进去。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, yes
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Hello, Ms
sentences.zh: 你好，女士。

sentences.en: Meyer
sentences.zh: 迈耶。

sentences.en: What can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: When I viewed the house, I told you I'll most probably need to rent some furniture, at least until I know whether my temporary work contract is going to be made permanent
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我看房时曾告诉过您，我极有可能需要租一些家具，至少在确定我的临时工作合同是否会转为长期合同之前都需要。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, of course
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，当然可以。

sentences.en: I remember
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: And I said I could give you some information about furniture rental companies in the city
sentences.zh: 我当时说可以给您提供一些本市家具租赁公司的信息。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, the biggest company is called Peak Rentals
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，最大的一家公司叫峰顶租赁公司（Peak Rentals）。

sentences.en: I've recommended them to other people and have always heard positive reports about them
sentences.zh: 我曾向其他人推荐过他们，而且一直听到关于他们的正面评价。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Could you give me an idea of their costs?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您能大概告诉我他们的收费情况吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Sure
sentences.zh: MAN: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I actually have one of their brochures here
sentences.zh: 我这儿正好有一份他们的宣传册。

sentences.en: It says the monthly price per room starts at $105 and goes up to $239
sentences.zh: 上面写着每间房的月租金从105美元起，最高达239美元。

sentences.en: That depends on which rooms you need furniture for, of course
sentences.zh: 当然，具体价格取决于您需要为哪些房间配备家具。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sure
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 当然。

sentences.en: It's just to get a general idea of how much it's going to cost
sentences.zh: 这只是为了大致了解一下费用会是多少。

sentences.en: And you said you had some positive feedback about this company?
sentences.zh: 而且您说您对这家公司有一些正面反馈？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的。

sentences.en: People have mentioned that the furniture from Peak Rentals is more modern than any of the other companies
sentences.zh: 人们提到Peak Rentals公司的家具比其他任何公司的都要更现代。

sentences.en: And also, once you place an order, the furniture will be delivered to you in just one or two days
sentences.zh: 此外，一旦您下了订单，家具将在一到两天内送货上门。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That would be really helpful
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这确实会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, and the brochure says that there's a special offer at the moment
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，还有，宣传册上说目前有一项特别优惠。

sentences.en: If you rent living room furniture, I believe that's a set of chairs and a TV table, you'll also get a lamp at no extra cost
sentences.zh: 如果您租用客厅家具——我相信这包括一套椅子和一张电视桌——您还将免费获赠一盏台灯。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay, but you know, that price range you gave is more than I was hoping to pay
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，但您知道，您刚才给出的这个价格区间比我原本希望支付的要高。

sentences.en: MAN: Then you could try Aaron and Oliver
sentences.zh: MAN: 那您可以试试Aaron和Oliver公司。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sorry, what and Oliver?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 抱歉，是‘什么’和Oliver？

sentences.en: MAN: Aaron, double A-R-O-N
sentences.zh: MAN: Aaron，双A-R-O-N。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK, are they cheaper
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，他们更便宜吗？

sentences.en: MAN: I say they are a mid company But if you chose them you need to be aware that they charge an extra 12 every month in case of damage
sentences.zh: MAN: 我觉得他们属于中等价位的公司。但如果您选择他们，需要注意的是，他们每月会额外收取12英镑，以应对可能发生的损坏。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, I see
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.en: I'd have to do the math carefully then
sentences.zh: 那我就得仔细算一算了。

sentences.en: MAN: Right
sentences.zh: MAN: 没错。

sentences.en: But one helpful thing is that they also do cleaning for customers
sentences.zh: 但有一点很有帮助：他们也为客户提供清洁服务。

sentences.en: WOMAN: For the furniture?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是为家具清洁吗？

sentences.en: MAN: For the house
sentences.zh: MAN: 为了房子。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, I see
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.en: I probably won't need that
sentences.zh: 我可能不需要那个。

sentences.en: MAN: There's another company called Larch Furniture
sentences.zh: MAN: 还有一家公司叫山毛榉家具公司。

sentences.en: It's quite new, and it has the lowest prices in town
sentences.zh: 这家公司很新，而且是镇上价格最低的。

sentences.en: That's for both furniture and also electronic equipment
sentences.zh: 这既包括家具，也包括电子设备。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, that would be good
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，那倒不错。

sentences.en: I'm not bringing much with me, and I won't have much time to go shopping after I start my job
sentences.zh: 我不会带太多东西过去，而且开始工作后，我也没多少时间去购物。

sentences.en: MAN: There are two things you need to know about large furniture
sentences.zh: MAN: 关于大型家具，您需要了解两点。

sentences.en: First of all you have to take out insurance on the furniture and you need to organize that yourself
sentences.zh: 首先，您必须为家具购买保险，而且需要您自己办理。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That wouldn't be too hard
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那应该不会太难。

sentences.en: MAN: Also you can take out a contract for less than six months but I figure that might not be a problem for you
sentences.zh: MAN: 此外，您也可以签订不足六个月的租赁合同，不过我想这对您来说可能不是问题。

sentences.en: You're renting the house for 12 months after all, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 毕竟您租这套房子为期12个月，对吧？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, okay
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，好的。

sentences.en: Well, I
sentences.zh: 嗯，我……

sentences.en: MAN: Sorry to interrupt
sentences.zh: MAN: 抱歉打断一下。

sentences.en: I just thought of another furniture rental company
sentences.zh: 我刚刚又想到另一家家具租赁公司。

sentences.en: It's called Space Rentals, and it's located very near to the house
sentences.zh: 它叫空间租赁公司，位置离您要租的房子非常近。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: MAN: I don't have any information about their charges, so it's best to use their app to find out what it would cost you to use them
sentences.zh: MAN: 我没有关于他们收费标准的任何信息，所以最好使用他们的应用程序来查询您使用其服务所需支付的费用。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay, thanks
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: I'll do that
sentences.zh: 我会照做的。

sentences.en: MAN: One good thing about that company is that if you don't like the furniture once it's delivered, you can request exchanges, as long as you do that within a week of receiving it
sentences.zh: MAN: 那家公司一个很大的优点是：一旦家具送达后您不满意，只要在收货后一周内提出，就可以申请更换。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That sounds really great
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来真不错。

sentences.en: Okay, well, thanks very much
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: That's so helpful
sentences.zh: 这真是太有帮助了。
